entities.name: Mahanama of Anuradhapura
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mahanama was King of Anuradhapura in the 5th century, whose reign lasted from 412 to 434. He succeeded his brother Upatissa I as King of Anuradhapura and was succeeded by his son Soththisena.
